en.name: iHomeWise
en.short_description: Mortgage affordability, monthly payment and amortization calculator
en.subtitle: What house can I afford?
en.description:
HomeWise answers one question properly: what can you actually afford, and what will it cost you every month?

AFFORDABILITY
Enter your household income, the cash you have, and your existing debt. HomeWise applies front-end and back-end debt-to-income limits and tells you the price range those limits put you in — and which limit is the one binding you.

PAYMENT
Break a monthly payment into principal, interest, taxes, insurance, and the costs that scale with price, so you can see what is loan and what is everything else.

SCHEDULE
The full amortization schedule, payment by payment, with the crossover month where you start paying more principal than interest.

COMPARE
Save scenarios and put them side by side. Different price, different rate, different down payment — the same maths on all of them.

ASSUMPTIONS YOU CONTROL
Rates, tax rates, insurance, and the DTI limits are all yours to change, and HomeWise shows you the assumption behind every number instead of hiding it. It is a calculator, not a lender: it does not pull your credit, does not talk to a bank, and does not need an account.

ADS
HomeWise shows ads from Google AdMob. Google may use device identifiers to serve and measure those ads. HomeWise does not track you across other companies' apps, and where the law requires consent you are asked before any ad is requested. The figures you enter are not sent with ad requests: the calculations and your saved scenarios stay on the device.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
HomeWise answers one question properly: what can you actually afford, and what will it cost you every month?

Intended audience:
What house can I afford?

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
No account and no login are required. The app opens on the Afford tab; the bottom bar reaches the other four (Monthly, Schedule, Compare, Assume). There is no property-listings feature in this build: no listing feed is connected, so that tab is left out rather than shown empty.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, fred.stlouisfed.org): the app downloads the published weekly average mortgage rate (Freddie Mac PMMS, 30- and 15-year series) to pre-fill the rate field. Public, keyless; nothing the user enters is sent. If it cannot be reached the user types a rate.
- Firebase (Google): Crashlytics crash reports, Performance Monitoring and Analytics usage events, not linked to the user and not used for tracking. Remote Config is initialised but carries no app content.
- Google AdMob (ads): banner ads, and an occasional interstitial between tabs (frequency-capped), served by Google. Google may use device identifiers to serve and measure ads. The setup is non-tracking (no App Tracking Transparency prompt, no cross-app tracking), and in the EEA, UK and Switzerland Google's consent form (UMP) is shown before any ad is requested; a "Privacy choices" row under the Assume tab reopens it there. Nothing the user enters is sent with an ad request.
All calculations and saved scenarios stay on the device; there is no account and no server of our own.

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app's interface text is in English. System controls and a few shared labels (tab names such as Browse, Save, Cancel, Delete) follow the device language, but the calculator screens are not yet translated, so no other language is claimed. Figures are in US dollars and the lending limits follow US conventions. Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
The app creates no account, so there is nothing to delete.
